title: Environmental Regulations & Passive se
goal: Control passive se agreement in compound tenses, modal periphrases and infinitive-subject rules in environmental law.

items: I can match plural nouns with plural modals (*se deben controlar*) and compound tenses (*se han aprobado*) in passive *se*.
I can keep the verb singular when an infinitive clause is the subject (*se prohíbe talar* vs *se prohíben las talas*).
I can use core terms for wetlands, waste discharges, logging, conservation, recycling and ecological restoration.
